en-GB.name: 4NextTram
en-GB.summary: Live Dublin Luas tram times for any stop, plus a favourite stop you can ask about with one phrase.
en-GB.description:
This skill tells you the next Dublin Luas trams from your chosen stop, using the National Transport Authority's real-time data. Luas is Dublin's tram network.

Set or change your favourite stop by saying "Alexa, ask four next tram to set my favourite stop to Dundrum northbound". Then simply asking "Alexa, ask four next tram" gives you your local trams. Get a reminder of your favourite stop by saying "Alexa, ask four next tram for my favourite stop". Get trams for any stop by saying "Alexa, ask four next tram for Dundrum southbound".

You can say northbound, southbound, going north, going south, eastbound or westbound where that applies, towards the city, or towards a terminus such as Broombridge or Brides Glen.

Where live information is not available, timetable times are given instead.

Note: this is not an official Luas, Transdev, or TFI skill. It uses publicly available real-time information provided by the National Transport Authority.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask four next tram for Dundrum southbound
Alexa, ask four next tram to set my favourite stop to Sandyford towards the city
Alexa, ask four next tram for the next tram

publishingInformation.testingInstructions:
No account linking. English (UK) locale. Ireland and UK distribution. This skill covers Dublin Luas trams.

1. Ask four next tram for Dundrum southbound. Expect tram times towards Brides Glen.
2. Ask four next tram to set my favourite stop. When prompted, say Broadstone going south. Expect confirmation of Broadstone DIT southbound.
3. Ask four next tram for the next tram. Expect the saved favourite.
4. Ask four next tram for Heuston eastbound (Red Line) and for Dawson southbound (city centre).
5. Help and Stop should work.

Live times come from the NTA GTFS-Realtime feed; if live data is unavailable the skill says scheduled (timetable) times.
